_comment: Release gates: which GitHub milestones must be COMPLETE (0 open issues) before a version tag may ship. Enforced by tools/check_release_milestones.py, wired into release.yml and (spec) wylde-release publish. GitHub has no native milestone ordering/dependency, so ordering is declared HERE explicitly and cross-checked against reality: any milestone whose title starts with a release's `prefix` but is NOT listed in requires_milestones fails the gate (so adding a 0.2 milestone and forgetting to list it can't silently pass). A version tag with no entry here fails CLOSED.
